svg.title: Agentic RAG System Architecture
svg.desc: Layered architecture for the Agentic RAG platform.
svg.text: Next.js frontend, nginx gateway, FastAPI backend, shared Qdrant/BM25 storage, Groq/Hugging Face/Tavily providers

g.text: pdf, docx, txt, md, csv, json
RAG, Web, Calculator, Combined, Recovery merge

svg.text: Recovery may call document_navigation (section-level) on step 2+
Upload -> parse -> chunk -> embed -> Qdrant + BM25
List/get/delete; duplicate checksum; rollback on failure
Railway: public frontend only; private gateway, backend, Qdrant
Stateless FastAPI replicas share Qdrant and BM25 index volume. Groq handles LLM tasks; Hugging Face handles embeddings.
QueryRouter selects rag_retrieval, tavily_web_search, and/or calculator. document_navigation is recovery-only.
Agent runs stored in SQLite unless a Railway volume is mounted.
